exposure: Time passed since the last cesarean section
Location of incision in the abdomen
Scar status with respect to skin
cohort: 105 pregnant women who had undergone previous cesarean section surgery by the same physician, were at least in their 30th gestational week, had surgery notes about their previous operation, and had no chronic diseases
finding: Depressive and hypopigmented abdominal scars may be associated with pelvic adhesions.
